# Tron Inc. Super Representative Node Rises to Number 1 Rank on TRON Network


by[\[email protected\]](https://srmentertainment.com/author/chrissimplythebestdigital-com/)


| Oct 21, 2026


|[Press Releases](https://srmentertainment.com/category/press-releases/)


Winter Park, Florida, Oct. 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Tron Inc. (Nasdaq: TRON), the largest publicly traded holder of TRON (TRX) tokens, today provided an update on its TRON network integration initiatives.


Strong community support in token delegation has elevated the company’s Super Representative (SR) node to No. 1 in the current rankings, with approximately 3.71 billion delegated TRX tokens as of October 21, 2026, underscoring rapid growth since its official SR election earlier this month.


To further broaden recurring on-chain revenues and deepen its integration with the Tron Network infrastructure, Tron Inc. intends to operate multiple nodes leveraging its proven technical framework.


These steps come as the TRON network experiences rapid growth in stablecoin activity, now hosting over $94 billion or more than 50% of global USDT stablecoin circulation and reinforcing its position as the leading settlement protocol for on-chain payments.


“Our rising SR rank reflects a strong vote of confidence by the Tron community that positions us to increase participation in the TRON ecosystem and expand revenue streams through further infrastructure integration,” said Rich Miller, Tron Inc. CEO.


**About Tron Inc.**


Tron Inc. is a publicly traded company pioneering integrated treasury strategies. As the public company with the largest TRON (TRX) tokens holdings, Tron Inc. is committed to transparency, and the adoption of decentralized finance for long-term value creation. In addition, through its wholly owned subsidiary, the Company designs, develops, and manufactures custom merchandise which includes toys and souvenirs for the world’s largest theme parks and other entertainment venues. Many of the Company’s products are based on award winning multi-billion-dollar entertainment franchises that are featured in popular movies and books. The products are distributed worldwide at Walt Disney Parks and Resorts, Universal Parks and Destinations, United Parks and Resorts SeaWorld, Six Flags and other attractions.
